payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the factors contributing to the success of the path-based model, particularly the hypo2path model, by highlighting its training methodology and performance metrics.

claims.text: The hypo2path model's success is attributed to its training on the entire hypernym path prediction, which is a more complex task than direct hypernym prediction, leading to stronger model performance.
The model's performance is enhanced by ensuring that all evaluated queries are new to both path-based and non-path models, preventing any advantage from prior exposure during training.
The hypo2path model achieved significant improvements in accuracy metrics (H@1) over benchmark models, indicating its effectiveness in hypernym prediction tasks.
